newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux to build Brazil fridge factory.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux to build Brazil fridge factory.

text.p: Swedish appliance maker Electrolux on Wednesday announced an agreement with the state of Parana in Brazil to build a fridge factory.
Electrolux said in a statement the Electrolux/Refripar factory would involve an investment of $150 million over three years and employ 1,200 people.
The factory for refrigerators and freezers will be located near Curitiba, the capital of Parana, and will be operational in 1999/2000.
The potential annual capacity is 1.5 million units.
The output will be sold mainly in the domestic market but also throughout Latin America particularly in the Mercosur.
Electrolux and Refripar, a Brazilian white-goods company, last week announced they were studying a merger of Electrolux's two wholly owned Brazilian subsidiaries with Refripar.
Electrolux currently has 98 percent of ordinary shares in Refripar and 35 percent of the share capital and would get additional ordinary shares in Refripar in exchange for the transfer.
